svg.text: Same contact card: position, band edges, electric field and space charge
Ec solid / Ev dashed; metal EF at x < 0
Blue: V=-0.2 V Red: V=0 V Green: V=+0.2 V
Grey dashed: semiconductor bulk reservoir EF; not an interface distribution function.
At x=0, Ec-EFmetal=0.600 V x q for every bias; Ec-EFbulk changes with bias.
Single isotropic valley, MB supply, fully ionized ND=1e22 m^-3; not a silicon process model.
